note: Triennial election of councillors (two per ward; no aldermanic elections this year), polled on Wednesday 21 May 1958. The Larne Times nomination list names all six wards; after Matthew Gillespie withdrew in West Ward the only poll was in North Ward. Eden Ward had a single nominee for two seats and one councillorship there was left vacant. Two nominees for two seats. Printed 'East Central'. Returned unopposed.
